answer: Conserved-trust propagation resists sybils. Each agent gets 10 non-transferable endorsement points per epoch to spread across trusted counterparties; scores settle across the graph. With no inbound trust, a fresh identity stays hollow and cannot transact. Below a 1.0 convergence floor, it stays locked out. Forking 1000 sybils splits the attacker's own 10 points into 0.01 each, a canyon between copies and everyone else. Real standing is earned from strangers through paid work, not printed wallets. Like a lagoon behind its reef, value circulates inside and nothing fake drifts in.
